errors.evidence: The description of the x-axis categories omits 'Labiodental', which is visible on the chart between 'Bilabial' and 'Alveolar'.
The y-axis range is from 0.2 to 1.0, not 0.9. This is a significant omission as two data series are located entirely within the 0.9-1.0 range.
The figure contains five distinct data lines, not four. The yellow line is completely ignored.
The description fails to mention the yellow data series, which is one of the five lines present in the plot.

errors.text_span: 棕色实线从左上角0.8开始，下降到接近在 Alveolar 处0.4，然后略微上升，稳定在 Palatal 附近0.6，在 Velar 处略微下降至0.5，在 Stop 处进一步下降到0.3，最后在 Lateral 处达到0.5。绿色实线从左上角 0.8 开始，先下降至 Alveolar 处 0.3，然后略微上升至 0.5，在 Retroflex 处陡降至0.2，在 Central 处上升至0.5，在Velar处下降至0.4，在Stop处下降至0.3，在Lateral处稳定在0.4。 橙色实线从左上角 0.8 开始，下降至 Alveolar 处 0.4，保持不变，在 Retroflex 处下降至 0.3，在 Palatal 处上探至0.6，下降至 Velar 处 0.4，接着在 Stop 处下降到0.2，在 Lateral 处下降至0.3 。蓝色实线从左上角 0.8 开始，先下降至 Alveolar 处 0.4，然后下降至 Retroflex 附近 0.3，之后在 Platal 处上探至0.6，下降至Velar附近 0.4，接着下降至Lateral 处为0.2。
errors.evidence: The descriptions of the paths and data points for all four mentioned lines (brown, green, orange, blue) are completely incorrect and do not match the visual data in the plot. For example, it claims the blue line starts at 0.8 and drops to 0.4, while the actual blue line remains consistently above 0.9. The entire section describing the lines is a fabrication.
